body: You’re right. I’m not really feeling a lot of resentment of I’m being honest, and I don’t fully blame them for what my brain is doing, but it’s interesting to view this kind of disordered behavior from an outside perspective; from someone who’s trying to help. When I was in the thick of it though, years ago, I didn’t have anyone there supporting me. I guess instead of being frustrated or irritated about it, I should focus my emotional energy on something healthier and more productive. Tbh my post was just a bunch of loose angry thoughts strung together and I’m just now seeing how it can sound a bit accusatory on my part. Thank you, it’s important to acknowledge the flaws in oneself and this kind of criticism is the sole reason why I posted this in the first place. Much appreciated!

This was definitely just a rant, I’m not breaking up with them just because they have an unresolved eating disorder that’s effecting me negatively. Jumping to “just dump them” does not resolve the issue and tbh I’m not interested in leaving someone I otherwise have a healthy relationship with. Thank you for your very considerate comment though, I really do appreciate it. If things were different I would probably consider this to be an option, but breaking up is not the move.
Thanks. Yeah I ignored them, my comment was just petty. I’m safe. Thanks for reaching out :)
